newsitem.title: GREECE: ASPIS MUTUAL FUND ASSETS GREW TO 30 BLN DRS IN 96.
newsitem.headline: ASPIS MUTUAL FUND ASSETS GREW TO 30 BLN DRS IN 96.

text.p: Aspis Mutual Funds increased their assets under management to over 30 billion drachmas in 1996, the fund management company said on Thursday.
Aspis Income fund ended the year with a return of 15.27 percent, when the average one-year T-bill yield reached 12.80 percent.
Aspis Money Market fund returned 13.7 percent in 1996 even though interest rates were constantly falling during the same year, the company said.
Aspis International Bond fund returned 8.58 percent as foreign currency bank deposits offered returns of -0.6 percent in deutsche marks, 5.0 percent in ecu and 9.2 percent in U.S. dollars, it said.
The Aspis Group has one of the largest financial service networks in Greece, employing a total of 1,400 people. --Margarita Sotiropoulou, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
